parts.title: Fund learning in stages
parts.body: Discovery establishes the workflow and baseline. A prototype tests feasibility on representative cases. Controlled production tests reliability, adoption, and actual value. Scale requires stronger evidence and a support plan. Set a decision, evidence requirement, owner, and spending cap at each stage.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Write a gate memo
parts.body: A claims summarizer passes a small technical test but produces wrong citations on rare cases. Keep the next investment limited to a monitored pilot with review and a citation error threshold. State which result would trigger scale, redesign, or cancellation.
parts.label: Apply
